related.description: ☔️ A complete Go cache library that brings you multiple ways of managing your caches
gdcache is a pure non-intrusive cache library implemented by golang, you can use it to implement your own cache.
groupcache is a caching and cache-filling library, intended as a replacement for memcached in many cases.
A Binary Memcached client for Go with support for sharding using consistent hashing, along with SASL.
